---
title: "Quality of life — primary estimand"
subtitle: "Weeks in good states (1–3) over 26 weeks"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The primary contrast is the posterior-standardized treatment difference in
time in states 1–3 over 26 weeks. Standardization uses observed
principal-stratum participants; it is performed by `avg_sops()` and
`avg_comparisons()` with 200 posterior draws per imputation and mean SOP
summaries.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
data_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "imputations")
model_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "models")
draw_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "estimand"))
result_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("results", "primary", "quality-of-life"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: derive-qol-branches
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  sops_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("sops-%02d.rds", index))
  comparison_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("comparisons-%02d.rds", index))
  plot_sops_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("sops-%02d.png", index))
  plot_comparison_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("comparisons-%02d.png", index))
  if (!file.exists(data_path) || !file.exists(model_path)) stop("QoL estimand inputs are incomplete for imputation ", index, ".")
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-qol-estimand-%02d", index),
    input_paths = c(data_path, model_path),
    output_paths = c(sops_path, comparison_path, plot_sops_path, plot_comparison_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "quality_of_life", imputation = index,
                   posterior_draws = 200L, summary = "mean", good_states = 1:3,
                   horizon_weeks = 26L),
    worker = function() {
      data <- module_read_parquet(data_path)
      model <- readRDS(model_path)
      observed <- data[!duplicated(data$id), c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "yprev", "gap"), drop = FALSE]
      observed$yprev <- factor(observed$yprev, levels = 1:7, ordered = FALSE)
      sops <- markov.misc::avg_sops(
        model = model,
        newdata = observed,
        variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
        times = 1:26,
        y_levels = 1:7,
        absorb = NULL,
        p_var = "yprev",
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        include_re = FALSE,
        n_draws = 200L,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "qol", index),
        posterior_summary = "mean",
        return_draws = TRUE
      )
      comparisons <- markov.misc::avg_comparisons(
        model = model,
        newdata = observed,
        variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
        estimand = "time_in_state",
        state_sets = 1:3,
        times = 1:26,
        y_levels = 1:7,
        absorb = NULL,
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        p_var = "yprev",
        include_re = FALSE,
        n_draws = 200L,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "qol", index),
        posterior_summary = "mean",
        return_draws = TRUE
      )
      module_save_rds(sops, sops_path)
      module_save_rds(comparisons, comparison_path)
      if (!requireNamespace("markov.misc", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'markov.misc' is required for QoL plots.")
      ggplot2::ggsave(plot_sops_path, markov.misc::plot_sops(sops), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 120)
      ggplot2::ggsave(plot_comparison_path, markov.misc::plot_comparisons(comparisons), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 120)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: pool-qol-estimand
#| include: false
input_paths <- c(
  file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("comparisons-%02d.rds", indices)),
  file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("sops-%02d.rds", indices))
)
output_paths <- c(
  file.path(result_dir, "good-state-time-summary.parquet"),
  file.path(result_dir, "good-state-comparison-draws.parquet")
)
module_branch(
  runtime = runtime,
  stage_id = "primary-qol-estimand-pooling",
  input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = code_paths,
  metadata = list(endpoint = "quality_of_life", imputations = 50L, good_states = 1:3,
                 posterior_draws_per_imputation = 200L),
  worker = function() {
    comparisons <- lapply(indices, function(index) readRDS(file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("comparisons-%02d.rds", index))))
    if (length(comparisons) != 50L) stop("QoL pooling requires all 50 comparison branches.")
    draw_frames <- lapply(seq_along(comparisons), function(position) {
      draws <- attr(comparisons[[position]], "draws")
      if (is.null(draws) || !is.data.frame(draws)) stop("QoL comparison branch lacks posterior draws: ", position)
      names(draws)[names(draws) == "estimate"] <- "draw_value"
      draws$imputation <- indices[position]
      draws
    })
    pooled <- pool_equal_weight_draws(
      lapply(draw_frames, function(frame) frame["draw_value"]),
      n_draws = 200L,
      seed = analysis_seed(config, "reports")
    )
    pooled$draw <- pooled$draw_value
    summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(pooled$draw_value)
    summary$probability_benefit <- posterior_probability(pooled$draw_value)
    summary$good_states <- "1:3"
    summary$horizon_weeks <- 26L
    module_save_parquet(as.data.frame(summary), output_paths[1L])
    module_save_parquet(pooled, output_paths[2L])
  }
)
```
